faq.title: Rooms, answered
faq.sub: Everything about sharing files with a group.

items.q: Do I need an account to use rooms?
items.a: No. Rooms need no sign-up and no app — open bishare.app/rooms, create or join with a code, and share.

items.q: How long do shared files last?
items.a: Files in a Cloud room expire automatically after 24 hours. Local (P2P) files are only held in the browser during the session.

items.q: What's the difference between Cloud and Local rooms?
items.a: Cloud rooms relay files through encrypted storage so they work across any network. Local rooms send files directly browser-to-browser (P2P) — fastest on the same Wi-Fi, and nothing touches a server.
Local rooms send files peer-to-peer over encrypted WebRTC channels, so the bytes never reach our servers. Cloud rooms store files briefly in encrypted storage and delete them automatically.
Yes — rooms handle large files. On a fast local network, P2P rooms are especially quick.
